definition_used: Criminal legal proceedings were instigated in response to the publication and/or notice(s), or criminal legal proceedings resulted in the correction/EOC/retraction/etc.
caution: Criminal proceedings are a legal process external to the manuscript content; they may relate to research misconduct but the definition does not specify the underlying issue. Assigned to post-publication oversight as it involves legal response to publication.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes criminal legal proceedings instigated in response to publication or resulting in a correction/retraction. This is a legal process (process_signal: legal_process) involving government action (actor_context: ori_government). The problem object is the article in general (article_general) as the proceedings are about the publication. It fits post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight because it concerns legal oversight after publication, but it is broad as the underlying manuscript issue is not specified.
